The '''Morish language''' was a language spoken by the [[Morish]], a short [[Hair/Legends|furry]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morishim]]. In addition to a spoken language, the Morish also made use of certain [[Limb/Legends|hand]] signs for purposes such as haggling. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] were capable of speaking the Morish language.<ref name="SpecPast" />

==List of phrases==
*'''''W'simi p'routou?''''' &mdash; Interrogative<ref name="SpecPast" />
*'''''M'rish'kavish f'oril. M'shiskt C'aama', por kri'vres'mi B'oth.''''' &mdash; 'New information's been dug up about Caamas. It was the Bothans who were responsible.'<ref name="SpecPast" />
*'''''Ka'alee!''''' &mdash; Exclamation<ref name="SpecPast" />

==Notable non-native speakers of Morish==
*[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]<ref name="SpecPast" />
*[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]]<ref name="SpecPast" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Morish language first appeared in the novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and released in [[1997]].<ref name="SpecPast" />
